zh: 第 i 个读的章节，其记忆值会被计入之后每一次得分，也就是被计算 n−i+1 次；越早读的章节权重越大。
这是一个“值乘以递减权重”的配对问题：把大的值配给大的权重最优，这个交换论证对负数同样成立，所以直接按记忆值降序阅读。
把记忆值降序排序，维护当前已读章节的前缀和 prefix，每读一章先把它加进 prefix，再把 prefix 加到答案里；答案可能为负，也可能很大，用 64 位整数。
en: The chapter read i-th contributes its memory value to every later score, that is n-i+1 times; chapters read earlier carry larger weights.

This is a pairing of values with decreasing weights: matching larger values with larger weights is optimal, and the exchange argument also holds for negative values, so simply read in descending order of memory value.

Sort the memory values in descending order and keep a running prefix sum of the chapters read so far; for each chapter add it to the prefix, then add the prefix to the answer. The answer may be negative or large, so use a 64-bit integer.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Read in descending order of memory value and add up the prefix sum at each step.

## Proof of correctness

The value read i-th is counted in the next n-i+1 scores, so the weights decrease along the reading order. The exchange inequality that pairs larger values with larger weights holds for negative numbers as well, so descending order is optimal.

## Complexity

O(n log n) time and O(n) space.
